audience: managers who plan shifts and track hours in Shiftavo

useCases.title: See the shifts for a location
useCases.text: List the shifts in a date range, by location or position. Read the assignments of one shift, including the eligible employees.

useCases.title: Review timesheets and breaks
useCases.text: List the timesheets by employee, date and status. Read the breaks of one timesheet.

useCases.title: Check labor cost for a period
useCases.text: Get the labor-cost projection for a date range, for all locations or for some of them.

useCases.title: Check an employee's time balances
useCases.text: List the employees, then read the working-time and night-work balances of one employee.

useCases.title: Review open shift swaps
useCases.text: List the shift swap offers, optionally filtered by status.
